model_agnostic_meta_learning.summary: Meta-trains a starting policy so that a few gradient steps on the latest realised bars adapt it to the current regime, then adapts it that way for every block of the test walk.
model_agnostic_meta_learning.implementationNote: Bridge: tasks are blocks of the training span; the start policy is meta-trained (second order) so a few steps on a block's realised context maximise that block's tape reward. P(up) = the adapted policy's long share of long + short. Differs from the spec: adaptation reads only rewards already realised at the bar, once per block. Expect: a gain only where regimes outlast a block.
model_agnostic_meta_learning.estimatedTrainingTime: 30 s-3 min per fold, untuned (tuning multiplies it by the trials)

reptile_meta_learning.summary: First-order meta-learning: repeatedly fine-tunes a copy of the policy on one block of bars and moves the shared starting weights part of the way toward it; the test walk fine-tunes the same way on the latest realised bars.
reptile_meta_learning.implementationNote: Bridge: each block of the training span is a task; K SGD steps on it, then the start weights move toward the result (step annealed). P(up) = the adapted policy's long share of long + short. Differs from the spec: adaptation reads only rewards already realised at the bar, once per block; the market ignores the agent. Expect: close to the plain policy when regimes are short.
reptile_meta_learning.estimatedTrainingTime: 30 s-3 min per fold, untuned (tuning multiplies it by the trials)

reinforcement_learning_squared.summary: A recurrent policy that reads each bar together with its own earlier positions and the rewards they realised, so the learning happens inside its hidden state as the window unfolds.
reinforcement_learning_squared.implementationNote: Bridge: a GRU reads each bar of a fixed window with its own position h bars earlier and the reward that position has realised by now. P(up) = the last step's long share of long + short. Differs from the spec: trained by the exact expected-reward gradient (the tape prices every action) instead of PPO, and the hidden state restarts every window. Expect: close to a plain recurrent policy.
reinforcement_learning_squared.estimatedTrainingTime: 30 s-3 min per fold, untuned (tuning multiplies it by the trials)

probabilistic_embeddings_actor_critic.summary: Encodes the latest realised bars and rewards into a probabilistic task variable and conditions a soft actor-critic on it, so the policy knows which regime it is trading.
probabilistic_embeddings_actor_critic.implementationNote: Bridge: a product-of-Gaussians encoder turns realised (bar, reward) pairs into a latent task; a SAC actor and twin critics read it. P(up) = P(position > 0) under the actor's Gaussian. Differs from the spec: one-step soft Q (the market ignores the position), latent re-read once per block, and adaptation reads only realised rewards. Expect: a regime-conditioned policy near the base rate.
probabilistic_embeddings_actor_critic.estimatedTrainingTime: 10-60 s per fold, untuned (tuning multiplies it by the trials)

meta_policy_gradient.summary: An actor-critic whose discount and auxiliary reward are themselves learned: each block's policy step is judged by the true net reward of the next block, and that judgement tunes the return the agent learns from.
meta_policy_gradient.implementationNote: Bridge: actor-critic on the tape whose discount over the holding bars and learned auxiliary reward are meta-parameters; each inner step on a block is scored by the next block's net reward and the gradient flows back through it. P(up) = the final policy's long share. Differs from the spec: the market ignores the agent; no test-time adaptation. Expect: near a plain actor-critic.
meta_policy_gradient.estimatedTrainingTime: 10-60 s per fold, untuned (tuning multiplies it by the trials)

learning_to_learn_gradient_descent.displayName: Learning to Learn with Gradient Descent
learning_to_learn_gradient_descent.summary: A small recurrent network learns how to update another network's weights from their gradients, meta-trained on short fits over blocks of bars, and then trains the trading policy in place of Adam.
learning_to_learn_gradient_descent.implementationNote: Bridge: a coordinatewise LSTM optimiser (log-magnitude and sign gradient input) is meta-trained by unrolling fits of fresh policies on training blocks, then fits the final policy on the whole span. P(up) = that policy's long share. Differs from the spec: the market ignores the agent; the learned optimiser changes how the policy is fitted, not what it sees. Expect: close to an Adam-trained policy.
learning_to_learn_gradient_descent.estimatedTrainingTime: 10-60 s per fold, untuned (tuning multiplies it by the trials)

multitask_shared_latent_policy.displayName: Multitask RL with Shared Latent Variables
multitask_shared_latent_policy.summary: Splits the training span into regimes, trains one policy per regime and a shared policy distilled from all of them, each regime policy pulled toward the shared one (Distral).
multitask_shared_latent_policy.implementationNote: Bridge: k-means regimes of causal volatility and trend statistics are the tasks; each has a policy rewarded by the tape minus a divergence from a shared distilled policy. P(up) = the current regime's long share (the shared policy for a regime seen too rarely). Differs from the spec: one instrument, tasks are regimes; the market ignores the agent. Expect: near one pooled policy.

successor_features_transfer.summary: Learns what each of a library of simple rules will be exposed to over the coming bars, re-estimates which exposures the market is paying from the latest realised bars, and picks the best rule's action.
successor_features_transfer.implementationNote: Bridge: successor features of base rules (flat, long, short, follow or fade the top features) by LSTD; reward weights re-fit by ridge on realised one-bar moves, action by GPI; P(up) = Boltzmann share of long vs short, temperature fitted on validation. Differs from the spec: the market ignores the agent, so the rules' futures cancel in the long-short gap. Expect: a rolling factor-return call.
